name: reverse nordic curl
description: A kneeling lean backward with a straight line from knees to head, controlled by the thighs. It strengthens the quads at long lengths and stretches the hip flexors.
instructions: Kneel on a soft surface with your knees hip-width apart and toes pointed.
Squeeze your glutes so your hips stay straight.
Lean back slowly as one piece from your knees to your head.
Go only as far as you can still control.
Pull yourself back up with your thighs to the start.
